churn_resistance.rationale: Data access is behind one well-typed module and server functions are centralized, so a framework or upstream-API upgrade touches few files; the repeated hand-rolled not-found/title pattern and a few dead helpers are the only real churn surfaces.

findings.issue: Not-found is modeled as a { notFound: true } discriminator returned from loaders and rendered via <NotFoundPage/> in four routes, instead of the current notFound()/notFoundComponent API; the catch-all $.tsx route re-implements it again, and SSR serves a 200 where the framework would emit 404 (the spec explicitly encourages a 404 where the architecture allows).
findings.suggestion: throw notFound() from the loader (or return notFound({ routeId: rootRouteId })) and define one NotFoundPage as the root route's notFoundComponent; delete the $.tsx splat and the notFound field from the four data types.

findings.issue: Four exported helpers (trackable, formatHeight, formatWeight, compareText) are dead code, and height/weight formatting is duplicated inline in data.server.ts instead of using formatHeight/formatWeight.
findings.suggestion: Delete the unused exports or wire them into data.server.ts so the formatting rules live in one place.

findings.issue: Server-fn inputs use pass-through validators (.validator((data: T) => data)); the input is typed but not actually validated at the boundary, so a malformed client request reaches the data layer unvalidated.
findings.suggestion: Validate the small input shapes for real (return null on mismatch so the input becomes nullable), or use a minimal schema; at minimum reject non-strings/NaN pages rather than trusting them.

findings.issue: nitro is pinned to a pre-release RC (^3.0.261029-rc); RCs churn more than stable lines, and a future Start release may bump its required nitro.
findings.suggestion: Keep the caret but note the coupling in a comment, or follow the Start docs' lockfile guidance when Start moves nitro to stable.

findings.issue: The 'Not found – Pokédex' / `<name> – Pokédex` title ternary is copy-pasted across four route head()s (moves, abilities, types.$name, pokemon.$name).
findings.suggestion: Extract a small makeTitle(name?) helper (or handle the 404 title once in a root notFoundComponent) so the title rule lives in one place, matching the spec's single definition.

findings.issue: List keys are built as `${card.id}-${card.speciesName}` even though id alone is unique per species; the redundant key field invites confusion about the real identity of a card.

summary: This is a genuinely current TanStack Start app: it pins last week's stable releases, uses the now-canonical validator() server-function API, and its Vite/Nitro config matches the official Node hosting template verbatim. Dependencies are as lean as the framework allows and all PokeAPI access sits behind one well-typed module, so an upgrade would touch very few files. The one real miss is hand-rolling not-found handling instead of the framework's notFound()/notFoundComponent, which costs both idiomaticity and the spec-encouraged HTTP 404, alongside a few dead helpers and copy-pasted title logic.

apis.api: hand-rolled { notFound: true } flag + splat route
apis.replacement: notFound() thrown from loader + root notFoundComponent (NotFoundRoute-style hand-rolling is deprecated per the Router not-found guide)
